sideB.text:
JOHANNESBURG

Blue city art with a white upgrade panel and a green ring. No other text.

rules: Blue Infection card for Johannesburg. Same printed face as card 13, including the code P7-13b.
The white center panel is the infection-card upgrade slot.
notes: The corner code is P7-13b, the same code as card 13. It is not printed P7-14b. A difference of the two faces is only the shared texture, not a different code.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
